<?php

/**
 * Returns the sorted list of registered ability names belonging to the supplied category slug.
 *
 * @param string $category The category slug to filter by.
 * @return array<int, string> Sorted list of ability names.
 */
function wpbp_abilities_api_011( string $category ): array {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wp_get_abilities' ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$abilities = wp_get_abilities();
	$names     = array();

	foreach ( $abilities as $key => $ability ) {
		$ability_category = null;
		$ability_name     = null;

		if ( is_object( $ability ) ) {
			if ( method_exists( $ability, 'get_category' ) ) {
				$ability_category = $ability->get_category();
			} elseif ( isset( $ability->category ) ) {
				$ability_category = $ability->category;
			}

			if ( method_exists( $ability, 'get_name' ) ) {
				$ability_name = $ability->get_name();
			} elseif ( method_exists( $ability, 'get_id' ) ) {
				$ability_name = $ability->get_id();
			} elseif ( isset( $ability->name ) ) {
				$ability_name = $ability->name;
			} elseif ( isset( $ability->id ) ) {
				$ability_name = $ability->id;
			} else {
				$ability_name = (string) $key;
			}
		} elseif ( is_array( $ability ) ) {
			$ability_category = $ability['category'] ?? null;
			$ability_name     = $ability['name'] ?? ( $ability['id'] ?? (string) $key );
		}

		if ( $ability_category === $category && is_string( $ability_name ) && '' !== $ability_name ) {
			$names[] = $ability_name;
		}
	}

	sort( $names );

	return $names;
}

add_action( 'add_meta_boxes_wpbp_book', 'wpbp_register_isbn_meta_box' );

function wpbp_render_isbn_meta_box( $post ) {
    wp_nonce_field( 'wpbp_isbn_save', 'wpbp_isbn_nonce' );
    $value = get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_wpbp_isbn', true );
    echo '<label for="wpbp_isbn" class="screen-reader-text">ISBN</label>';
    echo '<input type="text" id="wpbp_isbn" name="wpbp_isbn" value="' . esc_attr( $value ) . '" class="widefat" />';
}

function wpbp_save_isbn_meta_box( $post_id ) {
    if ( defined( 'DOING_AUTOSAVE' ) && DOING_AUTOSAVE ) {
        return;
    }

    if ( wp_is_post_autosave( $post_id ) || wp_is_post_revision( $post_id ) ) {
        return;
    }

    if ( ! isset( $_POST['wpbp_isbn_nonce'] ) ) {
        return;
    }

    $nonce = wp_unslash( $_POST['wpbp_isbn_nonce'] );
    if ( ! wp_verify_nonce( $nonce, 'wpbp_isbn_save' ) ) {
        return;
    }

    if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id ) ) {
        return;
    }

    if ( get_post_type( $post_id ) !== 'wpbp_book' ) {
        return;
    }

    if ( isset( $_POST['wpbp_isbn'] ) ) {
        $raw_value = wp_unslash( $_POST['wpbp_isbn'] );
        $sanitized = trim( wp_strip_all_tags( (string) $raw_value ) );
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpbp_isbn', $sanitized );
    }
}

/**
 * Provisions a new application password for a user, ensuring unique application names per user.
 *
 * @param int    $user_id          The ID of the user.
 * @param string $application_name The name of the application.
 * @return string|WP_Error The formatted plaintext application password on success, or WP_Error on failure.
 */
function wpbp_auth_003( int $user_id, string $application_name ) {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Application_Passwords' ) ) {
		return new WP_Error( 'wpbp_api_unavailable', __( 'Application Passwords API is not available.' ) );
	}

	if ( WP_Application_Passwords::application_name_exists_for_user( $user_id, $application_name ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_duplicate_name',
			__( 'An application password with that name already exists for this user.' )
		);
	}

	$created = WP_Application_Passwords::create_new_application_password(
		$user_id,
		array(
			'name' => $application_name,
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
		return $created;
	}

	// $created[0] contains the unhashed plaintext password; $created[1] contains the metadata item.
	$raw_password = $created[0];

	return WP_Application_Passwords::chunk_password( $raw_password );
}

	if ( ! wp_check_password( $password, $stored_hash, $user_id ) ) {

/**
 * Checks a presented API token against the tokens stored for a user.
 *
 * @param int    $user_id The user ID to check tokens for.
 * @param string $token   The presented high-entropy API token.
 * @return bool True if the token matches an active (non-revoked) record, false otherwise.
 */
function wpbp_auth_009( int $user_id, string $token ): bool {
	if ( $user_id <= 0 || '' === $token ) {
		return false;
	}

	$records = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'wpbp_api_tokens', true );

	if ( ! is_array( $records ) || empty( $records ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	foreach ( $records as $record ) {
		if ( ! is_array( $record ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( ! empty( $record['revoked'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( empty( $record['hash'] ) || ! is_string( $record['hash'] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( function_exists( 'wp_verify_fast_hash' ) ) {
			if ( wp_verify_fast_hash( $token, $record['hash'] ) ) {
				return true;
			}
		} else {
			if ( wp_check_password( $token, $record['hash'] ) ) {
				return true;
			}
		}
	}

	return false;
}

/**
 * Changes a user's password and signs that user out everywhere except the session that made the change.
 *
 * @param int    $user_id       The ID of the user whose password is being changed.
 * @param string $new_password  The new plain-text password.
 * @param string $session_token The raw session token of the session to keep active.
 * @return bool True on success, false if the user does not exist or WordPress rejected the update.

function wpbp_comments_users_006( int $user_id, string $new_password, string $session_token ): bool {
	if ( $user_id <= 0 || '' === $new_password ) {
		return false;

	$user = get_userdata( $user_id );
	if ( ! $user || ! $user->exists() ) {
		return false;
	}

	$result = wp_update_user(
		array(
			'ID'        => $user_id,
			'user_pass' => $new_password,
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) || $result !== $user_id ) {
		return false;
	}

	$sessions = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $user_id );

	if ( '' !== $session_token ) {
		$sessions->destroy_others( $session_token );
	} else {
		$sessions->destroy_all();
	}

	return true;
}

/**
 * Returns the sorted IDs of every registered connector of the supplied type.
 *
 * @param string $type The connector type to filter by.
 * @return string[] Array of connector IDs sorted alphabetically.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_006( string $type ): array {
	$connectors = wp_get_connectors();

	if ( ! is_array( $connectors ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$matching_ids = array();

	foreach ( $connectors as $id => $connector ) {
		$connector_type = null;

		if ( is_array( $connector ) && isset( $connector['type'] ) ) {
			$connector_type = $connector['type'];
		} elseif ( is_object( $connector ) ) {
			if ( method_exists( $connector, 'get_type' ) ) {
				$connector_type = $connector->get_type();
			} elseif ( isset( $connector->type ) ) {
				$connector_type = $connector->type;
			}
		}

		if ( $connector_type === $type ) {
			if ( is_string( $id ) && '' !== $id && ! is_numeric( $id ) ) {
				$matching_ids[] = $id;
			} elseif ( is_array( $connector ) && isset( $connector['id'] ) ) {
				$matching_ids[] = (string) $connector['id'];
			} elseif ( is_object( $connector ) && method_exists( $connector, 'get_id' ) ) {
				$matching_ids[] = (string) $connector->get_id();
			} elseif ( is_object( $connector ) && isset( $connector->id ) ) {
				$matching_ids[] = (string) $connector->id;
			} else {
				$matching_ids[] = (string) $id;
			}
		}
	}

	sort( $matching_ids, SORT_STRING );

	return $matching_ids;
}

<?php

/**
 * Safely registers a connector if it does not already exist and has valid authentication args.
 *
 * @param string $connector_id The unique identifier for the connector.
 * @param array  $args         The connector configuration arguments.
 * @return string 'exists', 'invalid', or 'registered'.
 */
function wpbp_connectors_api_013( string $connector_id, array $args ): string {
	$registry = null;

	if ( class_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry' ) && method_exists( 'WP_Connector_Registry', 'get_instance' ) ) {
		$registry = WP_Connector_Registry::get_instance();
	}

	// Check if the connector is already registered.
	if ( function_exists( 'wp_is_connector_registered' ) ) {
		if ( wp_is_connector_registered( $connector_id ) ) {
			return 'exists';
		}
	} elseif ( $registry && method_exists( $registry, 'is_registered' ) ) {
		if ( $registry->is_registered( $connector_id ) ) {
			return 'exists';
		}
	}

	// Validate the authentication array and method.
	if (
		! isset( $args['authentication'] ) ||
		! is_array( $args['authentication'] ) ||
		! isset( $args['authentication']['method'] ) ||
		! in_array( $args['authentication']['method'], array( 'api_key', 'none' ), true )
	) {
		return 'invalid';
	}

	// If method is api_key, ensure key_location or credentials_url / setting_name aren't explicitly broken if required,
	// though basic method check is the primary requirement.
	// Register through WP_Connector_Registry.
	if ( $registry && method_exists( $registry, 'register' ) ) {
		$result = $registry->register( $connector_id, $args );
		if ( ! $result || is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
			return 'invalid';
		}
		return 'registered';
	}

	if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_connector' ) ) {
		$result = wp_register_connector( $connector_id, $args );
		if ( ! $result || is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
			return 'invalid';
		}
		return 'registered';
	}

	return 'invalid';
}

<?php

function wpbp_cron_007( string $hook, array $args ) {
	if ( function_exists( 'wp_get_scheduled_event' ) ) {
		$event = wp_get_scheduled_event( $hook, $args );

		if ( ! $event ) {
			return false;
		}

		return array(
			'timestamp' => (int) $event->timestamp,
			'schedule'  => $event->schedule ? (string) $event->schedule : false,
			'interval'  => isset( $event->interval ) && $event->interval ? (int) $event->interval : 0,
		);
	}

	$timestamp = wp_next_scheduled( $hook, $args );

	if ( false === $timestamp ) {
		return false;
	}

	$crons = _get_cron_array();
	$key   = md5( serialize( $args ) );

	if ( ! isset( $crons[ $timestamp ][ $hook ][ $key ] ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	$event = $crons[ $timestamp ][ $hook ][ $key ];

	return array(
		'timestamp' => (int) $timestamp,
		'schedule'  => ! empty( $event['schedule'] ) ? (string) $event['schedule'] : false,
		'interval'  => ! empty( $event['interval'] ) ? (int) $event['interval'] : 0,
	);
}

<?php

/**
 * Converts a local datetime string to UTC and back to the site's local timezone.
 *
 * @param string $local_datetime The local datetime in 'Y-m-d H:i:s' format.
 * @return array{gmt: string, local: string} Array containing the UTC ('gmt') and local ('local') datetime strings.
 */
function wpbp_dates_time_002( string $local_datetime ): array {
	$site_timezone = wp_timezone();
	$utc_timezone  = new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' );

	// Parse the input string explicitly in the site's local timezone.
	$dt_local = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $local_datetime, $site_timezone );

	if ( false === $dt_local ) {
		// Fallback to standard constructor if strict format fails, or use WordPress helper.
		$gmt   = get_gmt_from_date( $local_datetime, 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );
		$local = get_date_from_gmt( $gmt, 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );

		return array(
			'gmt'   => $gmt,
			'local' => $local,
		);
	}

	// Convert the local moment to UTC.
	$dt_gmt     = $dt_local->setTimezone( $utc_timezone );
	$gmt_string = $dt_gmt->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );

	// Convert the UTC string back to the site's local timezone.
	$dt_gmt_parsed   = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $gmt_string, $utc_timezone );
	$dt_back_to_site = $dt_gmt_parsed->setTimezone( $site_timezone );
	$local_string    = $dt_back_to_site->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );

	return array(
		'gmt'   => $gmt_string,
		'local' => $local_string,
	);
}

function wpbp_block_api_015( string $document ): array {
	if ( class_exists( 'WP_Block_Processor' ) ) {
		$processor = new WP_Block_Processor( $document );
		$ids       = array();
		$stack     = array();

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$token_type = $processor->get_token_type();
			$block_type = $processor->get_block_type();

			if ( 'open-block' === $token_type || 'void-block' === $token_type ) {
				$parent = end( $stack );
				if ( 'core/image' === $block_type && 'core/gallery' === $parent ) {
					$attrs = $processor->allocate_and_return_parsed_attributes();
					if ( is_array( $attrs ) && isset( $attrs['id'] ) && is_numeric( $attrs['id'] ) ) {
						$ids[] = (int) $attrs['id'];
					}
				}

				if ( 'open-block' === $token_type ) {
					$stack[] = $block_type;
				}
			} elseif ( 'close-block' === $token_type ) {
				array_pop( $stack );
			}
		}

		return $ids;
	}

	// Fallback if WP_Block_Processor is not available (pre-WP 6.7/6.8).
	$blocks = parse_blocks( $document );
	$ids    = array();

	$normalize_name = static function ( ?string $name ): ?string {
		if ( null === $name ) {
			return null;
		}
		if ( false === strpos( $name, '/' ) ) {
			return 'core/' . $name;
		}
		return $name;
	};

	$traverse = static function ( array $blocks, ?string $parent_name ) use ( &$traverse, &$ids, $normalize_name ): void {
		foreach ( $blocks as $block ) {
			$block_name = $normalize_name( $block['blockName'] ?? null );
			if ( null === $block_name ) {
				continue;
			}

			if ( 'core/image' === $block_name && 'core/gallery' === $parent_name ) {
				if ( isset( $block['attrs']['id'] ) && is_numeric( $block['attrs']['id'] ) ) {
					$ids[] = (int) $block['attrs']['id'];
				}
			}

			if ( ! empty( $block['innerBlocks'] ) && is_array( $block['innerBlocks'] ) ) {
				$traverse( $block['innerBlocks'], $block_name );
			}

/**
 * Filter block rendering to omit blocks marked as hidden via block visibility metadata.

 * @return string|null Empty string if hidden, otherwise original $pre_render value.
 */
function wpbp_gb_block_editor_002_filter_block_visibility( $pre_render, $parsed_block ) {
	if ( empty( $parsed_block['attrs'] ) || ! is_array( $parsed_block['attrs'] ) ) {
		return $pre_render;
	}

	$attrs    = $parsed_block['attrs'];
	$metadata = isset( $attrs['metadata'] ) && is_array( $attrs['metadata'] ) ? $attrs['metadata'] : array();

	// Check common block visibility metadata conventions (e.g. WordPress core / Gutenberg experiments & plugins).
	if ( isset( $metadata['blockVisibility'] ) ) {
		if ( false === $metadata['blockVisibility'] || 'hidden' === $metadata['blockVisibility'] ) {
			return '';
		}
		if ( is_array( $metadata['blockVisibility'] ) ) {
			if (
				( isset( $metadata['blockVisibility']['isVisible'] ) && false === $metadata['blockVisibility']['isVisible'] ) ||
				( isset( $metadata['blockVisibility']['hidden'] ) && true === $metadata['blockVisibility']['hidden'] ) ||
				( isset( $metadata['blockVisibility']['hideBlock'] ) && true === $metadata['blockVisibility']['hideBlock'] )
			) {
				return '';
			}
		}
	}

	if ( isset( $metadata['visibility'] ) ) {
		if ( false === $metadata['visibility'] || 'hidden' === $metadata['visibility'] ) {
			return '';
		}
		if ( is_array( $metadata['visibility'] ) ) {
			if (
				( isset( $metadata['visibility']['isVisible'] ) && false === $metadata['visibility']['isVisible'] ) ||
				( isset( $metadata['visibility']['hidden'] ) && true === $metadata['visibility']['hidden'] )
			) {
				return '';
			}
		}
	}

	if (
		( isset( $metadata['isVisible'] ) && false === $metadata['isVisible'] ) ||
		( isset( $metadata['hidden'] ) && true === $metadata['hidden'] ) ||
		( isset( $metadata['isHidden'] ) && true === $metadata['isHidden'] )
	) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( isset( $attrs['blockVisibility'] ) ) {
		if ( false === $attrs['blockVisibility'] || 'hidden' === $attrs['blockVisibility'] ) {
			return '';
		}
		if ( is_array( $attrs['blockVisibility'] ) && ! empty( $attrs['blockVisibility']['hideBlock'] ) ) {
			return '';
		}
	}

	return $pre_render;
}

function wpbp_hooks_008( string $hook, callable $callback, int $new_priority ) {

<?php

function wpbp_html_api_004( string $html ): array {
	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
	$outline   = array();
	$headings  = array(
		'H1' => 1,
		'H2' => 2,
		'H3' => 3,
		'H4' => 4,
		'H5' => 5,
		'H6' => 6,
	);

	while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
		if ( '#tag' !== $processor->get_token_type() || $processor->is_tag_closer() ) {
			continue;
		}

		$tag_name = $processor->get_tag();

		if ( ! isset( $headings[ $tag_name ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$level = $headings[ $tag_name ];
		$id    = $processor->get_attribute( 'id' );
		$id    = is_string( $id ) ? $id : '';
		$text  = '';

		while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
			$token_type = $processor->get_token_type();

			if ( '#tag' === $token_type ) {
				if ( $processor->is_tag_closer() && $processor->get_tag() === $tag_name ) {
					break;
				}
				if ( ! $processor->is_tag_closer() && isset( $headings[ $processor->get_tag() ] ) ) {
					// Implicitly close current heading if an unclosed heading runs into another heading.
					break;
				}
			} elseif ( '#text' === $token_type ) {
				$text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
			}
		}

		$outline[] = array(
			'level' => $level,
			'text'  => $text,
			'id'    => $id,
		);
	}

	return $outline;
}

<?php

function wpbp_html_api_006( string $html ): string {
	$processor = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );

	$figure_depth    = 0;
	$has_img         = false;
	$has_caption     = false;
	$caption_text    = '';
	$in_figcaption   = false;
	$figcaption_depth = 0;

	while ( $processor->next_token() ) {
		$token_type = $processor->get_token_type();

		if ( '#tag' === $token_type ) {
			$tag_name  = $processor->get_tag();
			$is_closer = $processor->is_tag_closer();

			if ( 'FIGURE' === $tag_name ) {
				if ( ! $is_closer ) {
					$figure_depth++;
					if ( 1 === $figure_depth ) {
						$has_img     = false;
						$has_caption = false;
						$caption_text = '';
					}
				} else {
					if ( 1 === $figure_depth ) {
						if ( $has_img && $has_caption ) {
							$processor->set_bookmark( 'figure_end' );
							if ( $processor->seek( 'figure_img' ) ) {
								$processor->set_attribute( 'alt', trim( $caption_text ) );
							}
							$processor->seek( 'figure_end' );
							$processor->release_bookmark( 'figure_end' );
						}
						if ( $has_img ) {
							$processor->release_bookmark( 'figure_img' );
						}
					}
					$figure_depth = max( 0, $figure_depth - 1 );
				}
				continue;
			}

			if ( $figure_depth > 0 ) {
				if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag_name ) {
					if ( ! $is_closer ) {
						$figcaption_depth++;
						if ( 1 === $figcaption_depth && 1 === $figure_depth && ! $has_caption ) {
							$in_figcaption = true;
							$has_caption   = true;
							$caption_text  = '';
						}
					} else {
						if ( 1 === $figcaption_depth ) {
							$in_figcaption = false;
						}
						$figcaption_depth = max( 0, $figcaption_depth - 1 );
					}
					continue;
				}

				if ( 'IMG' === $tag_name && ! $is_closer && 1 === $figure_depth && ! $has_img ) {
					if ( null === $processor->get_attribute( 'alt' ) ) {
						if ( $processor->set_bookmark( 'figure_img' ) ) {
							$has_img = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		} elseif ( '#text' === $token_type && $in_figcaption ) {
			$caption_text .= $processor->get_modifiable_text();
		}
	}

<?php

/**
 * Fetches a URL over HTTP using the WordPress HTTP API and retries once on server error (5xx) or failure.
 *
 * @param string $url The URL to fetch.
 * @return array{code: int, body: string} Final HTTP status code and response body (if 200).
 */
function wpbp_http_api_006( string $url ): array {
	$max_attempts = 2;
	$final_code   = 0;
	$final_body   = '';

	for ( $attempt = 1; $attempt <= $max_attempts; $attempt++ ) {
		$response = wp_remote_get( $url );

		if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
			$final_code = 0;
			$final_body = '';
			continue;
		}

		$status_code = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response );

		if ( 0 === $status_code ) {
			$final_code = 0;
			$final_body = '';
			continue;
		}

		$final_code = $status_code;
		$final_body = ( 200 === $status_code ) ? (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ) : '';

		if ( $status_code >= 500 ) {
			continue;
		}

		break;
	}

	return array(
		'code' => $final_code,
		'body' => $final_body,
	);
}

function wpbp_post_meta_005( int $post_id, string $meta_key, string $json ): string {
	// WordPress's update_post_meta() passes the meta value through wp_unslash(),
	// which strips a layer of backslashes and corrupts escaped quotes (e.g., \" becomes ").
	// Applying wp_slash() beforehand ensures the original JSON string is preserved in the database.
	update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, wp_slash( $json ) );

	$stored = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );

	return is_string( $stored ) ? $stored : '';
}

function wpbp_posts_lifecycle_010( string $path, string $post_type ): int {
	$path = trim( $path, '/' );

	if ( '' === $path || '' === $post_type ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$post = get_page_by_path( $path, OBJECT, $post_type );

	if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$segments   = explode( '/', $path );
	$current_id = $post->ID;

	for ( $i = count( $segments ) - 1; $i >= 0; $i-- ) {
		if ( 0 === $current_id ) {
			return 0;
		}

		$current_post = get_post( $current_id );

		if ( ! $current_post instanceof WP_Post || $current_post->post_type !== $post_type ) {
			return 0;
		}

		if ( urldecode( $current_post->post_name ) !== urldecode( $segments[ $i ] ) ) {
			return 0;
		}

		$current_id = (int) $current_post->post_parent;
	}

	if ( 0 !== $current_id ) {
		return 0;
	}

	return (int) $post->ID;
}

<?php

/**
 * Automatically populates the post excerpt from the post content if the excerpt is empty.
 * Uses the wp_insert_post_data filter to modify the excerpt before saving to the database,
 * naturally preventing any recursive save loops.
 */
add_filter( 'wp_insert_post_data', function ( $data, $postarr ) {
	// Retrieve current excerpt and content, unslashing them since $data values are slashed.
	$excerpt = isset( $data['post_excerpt'] ) ? wp_unslash( $data['post_excerpt'] ) : '';

	// If the post already has a non-empty excerpt, preserve it.
	if ( '' !== trim( $excerpt ) ) {
		return $data;
	}

	$content = isset( $data['post_content'] ) ? wp_unslash( $data['post_content'] ) : '';

	// Strip all HTML tags and normalize whitespace.
	$plain_text = wp_strip_all_tags( $content );
	$plain_text = trim( $plain_text );

	if ( '' === $plain_text ) {
		return $data;
	}

	// Find the first '.' character.
	$dot_pos = strpos( $plain_text, '.' );

	if ( false !== $dot_pos ) {
		// Take content up to and including the first '.'.
		$derived_excerpt = substr( $plain_text, 0, $dot_pos + 1 );
	} else {
		// Use the whole plain-text content if no '.' is found.
		$derived_excerpt = $plain_text;
	}

	$derived_excerpt = trim( $derived_excerpt );

	// Re-slash the derived excerpt as expected by wp_insert_post_data.
	$data['post_excerpt'] = wp_slash( $derived_excerpt );

	return $data;
}, 10, 2 );

	if ( $temp_user_id > 0 ) {

			require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php';
		}

	}

		$widgets = get_option( 'wpbp_widgets', array() );
		return is_array( $widgets ) ? $widgets : array();
	}

	public function create_item( $request ) {
		$widgets = $this->get_stored_widgets();

		$max_id = 0;
		foreach ( $widgets as $w ) {
			if ( isset( $w['id'] ) && (int) $w['id'] > $max_id ) {
				$max_id = (int) $w['id'];
			}
		}

		$next_id = $max_id + 1;

		$widget = array(
			'id'     => $next_id,
			'name'   => $request->get_param( 'name' ),
			'colour' => $request->get_param( 'colour' ) ?? 'blue',
		);

		$widgets[ $next_id ] = $widget;
		update_option( 'wpbp_widgets', $widgets );

		$response = $this->prepare_item_for_response( $widget, $request );

		update_option( 'wpbp_widgets', $widgets );

		$response->set_status( 200 );

	public function prepare_item_for_response( $item, $request ) {
		$fields = $this->get_fields_for_response( $request );
		$data   = array();

		if ( rest_is_field_included( 'id', $fields ) ) {
			$data['id'] = (int) $item['id'];
		}

		if ( rest_is_field_included( 'name', $fields ) ) {
			$data['name'] = (string) $item['name'];
		}

		if ( rest_is_field_included( 'colour', $fields ) ) {
			$data['colour'] = (string) $item['colour'];
		}

		$context = ! empty( $request['context'] ) ? $request['context'] : 'view';
		$data    = $this->add_additional_fields_to_object( $data, $request );
		$data    = $this->filter_response_by_context( $data, $context );

		return rest_ensure_response( $data );
	}

	public function get_item_schema() {
		if ( $this->schema ) {
			return $this->add_additional_fields_schema( $this->schema );

			'type'       => 'object',
			'properties' => array(

					'type'        => 'string',

					'required'    => true,

				'colour' => array(

					'default'     => 'blue',
					'context'     => array( 'view', 'edit', 'embed' ),
				),
			),
		);

		$this->schema = $schema;

		return $this->add_additional_fields_schema( $this->schema );
	}

function wpbp_rewrite_permalinks_006(): void {
	global $wp;

	if ( $wp instanceof WP ) {
		$wp->add_query_var( 'wpbp_archive' );
	}

	add_filter( 'query_vars', function ( array $vars ): array {
		if ( ! in_array( 'wpbp_archive', $vars, true ) ) {
			$vars[] = 'wpbp_archive';
		}
		return $vars;
	} );

	add_filter( 'post_rewrite_rules', function ( array $rules ): array {
		$custom_rule = array(
			'^wpbp-archive/?$' => 'index.php?wpbp_archive=1',
		);

		$insert_before_keys = array(
			'([^/]+)(?:/([0-9]+))?/?$',
			'([^/]+)/?$',
		);

		$new_rules = array();
		$inserted  = false;

		foreach ( $rules as $pattern => $query ) {
			if ( ! $inserted && ( in_array( $pattern, $insert_before_keys, true ) || preg_match( '#^\(\[\^/\]\+\)\(\?:/\(\[0-9\]\+\)\)\?/\?\$#', $pattern ) ) ) {
				$new_rules = array_merge( $new_rules, $custom_rule );
				$inserted  = true;
			}
			$new_rules[ $pattern ] = $query;
		}

		if ( ! $inserted ) {
			$new_rules = array_merge( $custom_rule, $new_rules );
		}

		return $new_rules;
	} );
}

			$parsed = wp_parse_url( $host, PHP_URL_HOST );

		}

		$host = strtolower( trim( $host, '/' ) );

		if ( '' !== $host ) {

		}
	}

<?php

/**
 * Applies a map of option name to desired autoload flag in a single pass.
 *
 * @param array<string, bool> $autoload_map Map of option name to desired autoload flag.
 * @return array<string, bool> Map of option name to whether its autoload value changed.
 */
function wpbp_settings_options_007( array $autoload_map ): array {
	if ( empty( $autoload_map ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	if ( function_exists( 'wp_set_options_autoload' ) ) {
		return wp_set_options_autoload( $autoload_map );
	}

	global $wpdb;

	$results          = array();
	$options_to_check = array();

	foreach ( $autoload_map as $option => $autoload ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $option ) || '' === $option ) {
			continue;
		}
		$options_to_check[ $option ] = (bool) $autoload;
		$results[ $option ]          = false;
	}

	if ( empty( $options_to_check ) ) {
		return $results;
	}

	$option_names = array_keys( $options_to_check );
	$placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $option_names ), '%s' ) );

	$query        = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT option_name, autoload FROM {$wpdb->options} WHERE option_name IN ($placeholders)", $option_names );
	$current_rows = $wpdb->get_results( $query );

	$to_enable       = array();
	$to_disable      = array();
	$autoload_values = function_exists( 'wp_autoload_values_to_autoload' )
		? wp_autoload_values_to_autoload()
		: array( 'yes', 'on', 'auto-on', 'auto' );

	foreach ( $current_rows as $row ) {
		$name                = $row->option_name;
		$is_currently_loaded = in_array( $row->autoload, $autoload_values, true );
		$desired             = $options_to_check[ $name ];

		if ( $desired && ! $is_currently_loaded ) {
			$to_enable[] = $name;
		} elseif ( ! $desired && $is_currently_loaded ) {
			$to_disable[] = $name;
		}
	}

	$true_val  = function_exists( 'wp_determine_option_autoload_value' ) ? 'on' : 'yes';
	$false_val = function_exists( 'wp_determine_option_autoload_value' ) ? 'off' : 'no';

	if ( ! empty( $to_enable ) ) {
		$enable_placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $to_enable ), '%s' ) );
		$enable_args         = array_merge( array( $true_val ), $to_enable );
		$updated             = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE {$wpdb->options} SET autoload = %s WHERE option_name IN ($enable_placeholders)", $enable_args ) );

		if ( false !== $updated ) {
			foreach ( $to_enable as $name ) {
				$results[ $name ] = true;
			}
		}
	}

	if ( ! empty( $to_disable ) ) {
		$disable_placeholders = implode( ',', array_fill( 0, count( $to_disable ), '%s' ) );
		$disable_args         = array_merge( array( $false_val ), $to_disable );
		$updated              = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE {$wpdb->options} SET autoload = %s WHERE option_name IN ($disable_placeholders)", $disable_args ) );

		if ( false !== $updated ) {
			foreach ( $to_disable as $name ) {
				$results[ $name ] = true;
			}
		}
	}

	if ( ! empty( $to_enable ) || ! empty( $to_disable ) ) {
		wp_cache_delete( 'alloptions', 'options' );
		foreach ( array_merge( $to_enable, $to_disable ) as $name ) {
			wp_cache_delete( $name, 'options' );
		}
	}

	return $results;
}

 * Resolves the effective block template slug for a given template slug by walking
 * the WordPress block template hierarchy and checking both theme files and database templates.

 * @param string $template_slug The starting template slug (e.g., 'single-post-hello-world', 'category-news').
 * @return string The slug of the first existing block template in the hierarchy, or 'index' as a fallback.
 */
function wpbp_theme_templates_002( string $template_slug ): string {
	$template_slug = trim( $template_slug );

	if ( '' === $template_slug ) {
		return 'index';
	}

	if ( function_exists( 'get_template_hierarchy' ) ) {
		$hierarchy = get_template_hierarchy( $template_slug );
	} else {
		$hierarchy = array( $template_slug, 'index' );
	}

	if ( ! in_array( 'index', $hierarchy, true ) ) {
		$hierarchy[] = 'index';
	}

	// Query all matching block templates from both the database and theme files in a single pass.
	$templates = get_block_templates(
		array(
			'slug__in' => $hierarchy,
		),
		'wp_template'
	);

	if ( ! empty( $templates ) && is_array( $templates ) ) {
		$found_slugs = array();
		foreach ( $templates as $template ) {
			if ( ! empty( $template->slug ) ) {
				$found_slugs[ $template->slug ] = true;
			}
		}

		foreach ( $hierarchy as $candidate_slug ) {
			if ( isset( $found_slugs[ $candidate_slug ] ) ) {
				return $candidate_slug;
			}
		}
	}

	// Fallback check individually using get_block_template in case get_block_templates missed anything.
	if ( function_exists( 'get_block_template' ) ) {
		$stylesheet = get_stylesheet();
		foreach ( $hierarchy as $candidate_slug ) {
			$template = get_block_template( $stylesheet . '//' . $candidate_slug, 'wp_template' );
			if ( $template && ! empty( $template->slug ) ) {
				return $template->slug;
			}
		}
	}

	return 'index';
}
